text:
anya: quick proposal: 'config-pulse' = short live-preview + telemetry gate before any gradual rollout. want feedback on API + playbook.

ben: short version?

anya: operator triggers a pulse (10-60s window) that routes a tiny sampled percent (0.2%-0.5%) of real traffic through the new config path. we collect delta metrics and a lightweight eval set. UI shows green/yellow/red and suggests next step.

caroline: 0.2% sounds safe but how do we isolate billing/quota?

diego: we should mark pulse traffic as "preview: true" at ingress so downstream services and billing can ignore/mask it. router will tag headers and metrics.

anya: API sketch: POST /api/config/pulse { config_id, sample_pct, duration_secs, dedupe_key?, metrics: [...] } -> returns pulse_id. GET /api/config/pulse/{id}/summary -> safety_score + diffs + raw_links.

ben: sample request example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/api/config/pulse \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"config_id":"cfg:x","sample_pct":0.3,"duration_secs":30,"metrics":["latency_p95","error_rate","token_cost"]}'
```

ops-bot: note: staging branch for pulse feature live: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/pulse/78 :rocket:

caroline: what about cache semantics? KV prefix/cache could make diffs meaningless if cached responses served. we need to either flush or pin cache keys for pulse requests.

diego: agree. simplest: add header X-Preview-TTL=0 to bypass short-term caches for pulse. heavier option: a pinned shadow cache shard but that's more infra work.

anya: telemetry gating: pulse collects 1m aggregations and compares to baseline window of 15m pre-pulse. compute relative deltas and run small-sample A/B tests for text-quality/eval hooks.

ben: scoring algorithm idea: safety_score = max(0, 1 - weighted_sum([max(err_delta,0)*w1, max(lat_delta,0)*w2, quality_regressions*w3])). threshold 0.92 = ok to create gradual rollout.

caroline: need audit fields: pulse_id, operator, config_patch_hash, dedupe_key, start_ts, end_ts. retention: keep summaries for 90 days, raw traces 7 days.

diego: ops-safety: enforce budget cap per org and global concurrent pulses. pulse should not consume autoscaling credits or count against quota. implement quota-exempt flag for preview traffic.

anya: UX: small modal on config page: run pulse (0.1-0.5%) -> show card with safety_score, top-3 metrics, small chart sparkline, "apply 5% rollout" button, and "abort" if unsafe. also show ledger link to audit entry.

ben: can we do idempotency? add dedupe_key from client to avoid duplicates on double-clicks.

caroline: testing note: add e2e that runs pulse against canary infra and asserts safety summary format, and a unit test for score calc.

diego: infra note: router change needs a quick flag to flip sample-to-preview path and tag headers. impl is small but needs canary rollout itself. plan 2 days.

ops-bot: reminder: please add migration plan for metrics-backend tagging - tagging preview traffic will create extra series, consider rollup rules.

anya: followups: I'll open an RFC with API contract + example responses and a console mock. tagging @caroline for audit & retention, @diego for router patch, @ben for score calc.

ben: +1. I can prototype scoring function today.

caroline: will draft retention + audit schema and add to compliance docs.

diego: will prototype router header + cache bypass and share PR.

ops-bot: CI: pulse-prototype branch passed integration tests on staging: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/pulse/78/logs

anya: ok let's sync tomorrow 10:30 to align PRs. thanks. :thumbsup:
